title: GTA6 £350 Goodtime State Vice City Collection Revealed
description: Rockstar Games has revealed a £349 limited Goodtime State Vice City collection for GTA6, which does not include the game and is available for pre-order now.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Rockstar Unveils £350 GTA6 Goodtime State Vice City Collection

As the gaming world eagerly awaits the arrival of *Grand Theft Auto 6*, Rockstar Games has given fans a new way to empty their wallets. According to a recent report by Eurogamer, the studio has announced a limited-edition merchandise bundle for the highly anticipated title, carrying a hefty price tag and a few surprises.

### A Pricey Trip to Vice City

Dubbed the “Goodtime State Vice City” collection, this newly revealed lineup of physical goodies is tailored specifically for hardcore fans of the upcoming game. The collection leans heavily into the vibrant, sun-soaked, and chaotic aesthetic of Vice City. However, the most striking detail of this announcement is the price: a staggering £349.

While collectors might be tempted by the exclusive items included in the drop, there is a catch that has already sparked conversation across gaming communities. The £349 bundle **does not** include a copy of *Grand Theft Auto 6*. Buyers will be paying exclusively for the physical collectibles, meaning anyone wanting to actually play the game when it launches will need to purchase the software separately.

### Pre-Orders Live Now

Despite the steep price point and the absence of the game itself, Rockstar's official merchandise drops traditionally attract significant attention from dedicated collectors. Pre-orders for the Goodtime State Vice City collection are open now. Given the limited nature of such high-end merchandise releases, availability may be strictly constrained.

### Editor's Take

A £349 price tag for a collection that leaves out the actual game is a bold move, even for Rockstar Games. While it's clear this product is aimed squarely at die-hard collectors with deep pockets, most players will likely prefer to save their cash for the game itself. It's an ultimate test of fan loyalty.
